description:
Welcome to the next episode of our Chocolate Series!

In EP4, we look specifically at Valrhona cocoa powder and the resulting chocolate ice cream made with it. 

For the base, you'll need:

583g Milk & 1.8%
344g Cream @ 48%
80g Sugar
80g Dextrose
57g Valrhona Cocoa powder
60g SMP
2g Stabilizer mix which has emulsifiers in (optional)

---------------------

Check ou t the first episode of this series here:
https://youtu.be/6Przw3141ag

----------------------

If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://www.polaricecreamery.com


Thanks and see you on the next video :)

#valrhona #chocolateicecream #icecream #icecreamrecipe #gelato #chocolate

comments.text:
Ok, made this fabulous dark chocolate ice cream!!  As you recommended, I used 90% by the weight of Allulose for the total sugar, including dextrose, which came to 144 grams allulose..  I did not have any stabilizer left and used 2 eggs yokes.  The alulose % was spot on.  Not overly sweet but still nicely sweet, allowing those Valrhona dark cocoa powder flavors and notes to come thru.   It reminds me most of a Häagen-Dazs dark chocolate but better.  My only issue was not having the stabilizer or lecithin emulsifier.  Because of that, it could have a bit better creaminess and fewer ice crystals. 

 The good news is that the stabilizer and emulsifiers came in today.  So another quart gets made starting tomorrow.  This quart got crushed by my wife and daughter.  I think with the addition of 2 grams stabilizer ½ gram ?? should be spot on. My emulsifier is a separate powdered sunflower lecithin. Also, I have gotten in 100% milk protein to swap for the SMP to knock out those lactose sugar grams.  Should end up with only 12 grams carbs for the quart or 2 grams per scoop.  Easily keto ice cream and almost carnivore if it is vanilla as chocolate is not an animal product.

You are the man who will be sending a donation your way.  I have never gotten my ice cream quality this good before.  And it is so simple once someone takes the time to learn and share it as you have done.  After this chocolate, it's on to some of your other flavor creations.

Its crazy I can eat this and stay in ketosis, and it's sooooo good.

I've just gotten my hands on SpecialIngredients stabiliser mix, an Ice Cream machine and found wonderful ice creamery resources like yourself.

comments.author: @account123abcsame7

comments.text:
Hi Oliver, welcome to the club! Yes it could be used to substitute eggs to a degree. Egg yolks are a little different but I don’t use eggs much myself in my ice cream as it’s a myth it creates the best ice cream. 
If you use the Special Ingredients stabilizer, bring the heat slowly up and keep it at 75c for a few minutes, stirring gently. At that point the viscosity increases perfectly. 
Eggs are getting so expensive now, let those on TikTok waste a million at a time to make a point, we can get away without. 😉
